name: pf-fix-party-exit
about: fix-party-exit against the built package coop instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Issue #75 (mods/partyexit: override of WorldScript/Missions/LevelExitAreaNext.as). A floor exit opens once partyexit.share % of the living party (rounded up) stands in it, not everyone. Solo, 'hwp partyexit phantom <outside> [inside]' adds living players to the count: on dark_citadel floor 0, standing in the exit's area (exit_stand bot: the measurement verb teleport onto the exit's sensor, so no walk) and pressing Use is refused with 1 of 3 there (2 needed) and the 'Gather your party' announce (shot exit-refused), refused with 2 of 3 at Three quarters (3 needed), and taken with 2 of 3 at Two thirds (the next floor loads). cull and teleport are measurement verbs: setup only; what is under test is the exit's Use.

steps.pattern: \[HWP:partyexit\] self-check done: on, share 66%, 4 players need 3, 3 need 2
steps.name: partyexit module up
party of 3, only me at the exit
1 of 3 at the exit: no next floor (Use)

steps.pattern: \[HWP:partyexit\] exit refused: 1 of 3 at the exit, 2 needed: Gather your party: 2 of 3 must stand at the exit, 1 there now
steps.name: 1 of 3 refused
party of 3, 2 at the exit, three quarters
2 of 3 at Three quarters: no next floor (Use)

steps.pattern: \[HWP:partyexit\] exit refused: 2 of 3 at the exit, 3 needed: Gather your party: 3 of 3 must stand at the exit, 2 there now
steps.name: 2 of 3 refused at 75%
2 of 3 at Two thirds: the next floor loads (Use)

steps.pattern: \[HWP:partyexit\] exit opens: 2 of 3 at the exit, 2 needed
steps.name: 2 of 3 opens at 66%
